governing_rule: A provenance activity template is not a live provenance event.
purpose: Define the entity/activity/agent style chain the cube should use before it performs private capture, hashing, privacy review, content summarization, claim promotion, or public change-note display.
design_basis: W3C PROV model family as a conceptual guide
hard_stops: do not instantiate activities retroactively without receipts
do not omit privacy preflight between payload and summary
do not publish claims without rollback edges
nonclaim: The model is an operational template layer only.
